about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers winch-out and recovery, car and light truck transport, heavy and oversize loads. We work out of Lincolnton and the towns around it.

reviews.author: Nolan Green
reviews.text: The fine people at Hamptons absolutely saved me tonight (March 11, 2023), as I was on my way home from work, I ended up hitting a pot hole and lost all tire air pressure. I was alone, stranded so I gave them a call and spoke to this kind lady to see my opinions on what I could do, and soon enough her husband came out on such short notice and absolutely saved my butt tonight! I thank you so much to Hampton and the kind people that came to my rescue tonight!

reviews.author: Nicole Bivens
reviews.text: They were quick, professional, reasonably priced, and didnt up charge me at an unreasonable rate. 100% recommend

reviews.author: Shai
reviews.text: Just a young lady traveling and caught some tire and wheel trouble. Had to leave my car off to the side of the road until the next morning - Mr. Scott came and hooked my car up and got it back to Charlotte for me. This company was quite professional and more than understanding. Even the dispatch lady - bless her heart. She was probably sick of our calls but remained professional and kind. Mr. Scott - you never know what people are going through and the battles that they face daily - thank you from the bottom of my heart for being a kind gentlemen! He doesn’t play tho lol - if you’re kind to him, he’s kind to you. If you give him shit? Well… good luck. Thank you again Hamptons Wrecker! God bless you all.

reviews.author: Randy Barbee
reviews.text: Called for a wrecker. Woman who answered was more concerned about how I got her phone number than helping me. Told me to call someone else after I told her I had my credit card in my hand. Her own driver gave me her number and told me to call her. They left me stranded from 6pm until 10pm. Thanks, not.

reviews.author: Joseph Hewitt
reviews.text: Had the need to tow two cars from Winston-Salem to Huntersville. Both cars had been sitting for over a year and were located in difficult to reach places. Scott the driver handled the situation like a pro being very careful during the loading and transport process. This was done at a very reasonable price. I highly recommend Hampton's Wrecker Service.

reviews.author: Kris Vitale
reviews.text: On New Years Eve 2024, my 13 year old daughter and I were in a rental car that broke down in a very rural, isolated area. Scott from Hampton’s was our tow truck driver. When he got to us and realized that Roadside Assistance had not arraigned for my daughter and me to be picked up and brought home safely, he insisted on staying with us until he knew we were safe. Scott not only stayed with us (a single woman and a child) for well over an hour, but he did everything he could to help us make the connections necessary to get home safe and sound. Scott went above and beyond what his job duties entailed, and for a while, he was simply a kind hearted human being instead of being an on duty wrecker driver. The kind of people that a company employs speaks volumes about that company. To me, Hampton’s Wrecker Service is a top notch, A-1 company. I will never forget how far beyond my expectations of a tow company that Scott and Hampton’s went for us. I’m grateful that Scott was sent to us and kept us safe and warm until we could get safely out of the area. THANK YOU!

reviews.author: Elizabeth W.
reviews.text: Chris was so nice and quickly changed my tire when I got stuck on the side of the highway with a flat tire. My spare was not in great shape, so he let me follow his tow truck to a nearby tire shop in Lincolnton in case I had any issues along the way. I was able to buy a new tire and get right back on the road. Thank you so much, Chris!

reviews.author: Dorothy Cook
reviews.text: Great service. Friendly never long wait. Does a great job. My son has used them for years. He has 3 vehicles and never goes anywhere else.

reviews.author: Daniel Keith
reviews.text: Rudest customer service. I called the in a situation where my insurance gave me the run around for three hours at midnight and desperately needed to be towed 7 miles up the road, only to be met with a very rude response from a woman who said I needed to pay $260 to tow my car. Absolute robbery. Then she hung up on me when I told her to give me a moment while I checked my funds. I don’t understand how they stay in business if this is how they treat potential customers.

reviews.author: Cailey Speer
reviews.text: My experience with Hampton’s Wrecker service yesterday left much to be desired. I waited behind another couple for 10 minutes before anyone came to see what they or I needed only to be informed that I needed to go to a different building to handle paperwork to release the vehicle. When I got there they charged my grandfather $705 for towing, storage and a gate fee (?). This is because his truck was stolen early Saturday morning and the police had them tow and store it until the investigation was done. The $705 didn’t cover any of the damage being repaired because we are taking it elsewhere to get it fixed. After waiting 20-30 minutes for someone to assist us we finally got to finish the paperwork and they sent us out back to find the truck on our own. When I shifted the truck into gear it refused to move and it wasn’t so damaged that it could not drive. So finally I had to go find someone to ask for help and the guy said he flipped a switch on the bottom to keep it in neutral and he fixed that so I could leave. What should have taken 20 minutes or less took over an hour. They did the bear minimum and waited to be asked for help at every turn. I haven’t witnessed such poor customer service in a long time.

reviews.author: Ashley
reviews.text: I have used them twice in the last year. Both times they arrived within a few minutes of promised arrival time. (I called a 2 & 3 days before to schedule pickup)The scheduler and drivers were polite and helpful. My vehicles reached their destinations safely. Reasonable, competitive fees. Will use them again.

reviews.author: Roanoke Reviews
reviews.text: Although I've never locked myself out of my car before, that's exactly what happened when I recently found myself with a dead key fob battery and the wrong set of keys. The situation could have been a nightmare, but thankfully Hampton's Wrecker Service made everything so easy. Despite the late hour and it being Easter Eve, they arrived within 30 minutes and provided the smoothest service I've ever experienced from a roadside assistance provider - even topping my experiences with AAA. I can't thank them enough for their prompt and professional help. If you ever find yourself in a similar situation, I highly recommend this company for their exceptional service and efficiency.

reviews.author: Judy Dellinger
reviews.text: We locked our keys inside our truck today at Tractor Supply and AAA sent Hamptons. Their rep was so nice and quick. It was less than 10 minutes from time I called for help until he was there and opened the truck. Great experience.

reviews.author: Eric
reviews.text: Outstanding service. Son hit a deer at around 5 or 6 in the morning on 150. His car was not drivable and it was raining. They got him handled and taken to the tow yard, they do a lot of business with the body shop the car was going to and I passed the vehicle being transported there on my way home that afternoon, the same day. It's nice to know you can rely on a company to look after your kid who is just inexperienced with these sorts of things.

reviews.author: Jewelee Martin
reviews.text: Hampton's is great! John always makes time for our company trucks and has them back on the road quickly. I have tried many mechanics over the years with our business and personal vehicles and no one can compare. Excellent customer service and the "know how to fix your vehicle the first time" is hard to find but Hampton's has it and all for a reasonable price!

reviews.author: Brian Lunsford
reviews.text: I’ve had Hamptons work on both of my vehicles for a few years now. Extremely friendly and highly reliable. I recommend them to anyone who wants to beat the dealership prices and wants 10x the service.

reviews.author: Dena Sigman
reviews.text: Went above and beyond this morning when my car broke down, highly recommend to anyone needing services. Also, just to update anyone in the Denver/LKN area, Hamptons and Lineburger's are now one, so if you call Lineburger's number, you are connected to Hamptons

reviews.author: Kelly Roseboro
reviews.text: Jon is so sweet to me. I'm handicapped and he does everything he can to be accommodating. Treating old crippled ladies kind isn't his job. It's his personality. My husband went back with his truck to see if Jon could figure out the mysterious engine light that's been going on and off for years. We finally gave up. Jon figured it out and the price to fix it was great. I'm a woman. I don't like mechanics( you understand ladies). This one...I LIKE A LOT! He's MY mechanic from now on. THANK YOU JON.

reviews.author: Roger Whitesides
reviews.text: If you need a tow near Lincolnton call Hamptons. Not only did they tow me at 5am they fixed my problem and got me back going quick. So they are a towing and automotive shop.

reviews.author: Mindy G
reviews.text: Broke down in Shelby. Hamptons arrived within an hour, towed the vehicle to the repair shop and gave us a ride back to Lincolnton. These guys are all about customer service. Used them several times. Never had a bad experience. They're straight up.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Sarment
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a completely unprofessional clown show, these are your guys. I guess they’re cheap though.

reviews.author: Temperance Lykins
reviews.text: Billy Hampton and William Lynch is so nice. My car broke down at Mrytle Beach and they brought our other vehicle to us on July 4. Not many people would do that. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Angel Cloninger
reviews.text: We had to have our truck and camper towed when we broke down on our way out of town. They were fast, nice and fair priced. Appreciate the courtesy and quick service.

reviews.author: Jessica Jordan
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about Hampton’s. They charge half what other wreckers charge. They have always taken such good care of me and are super honest and kind. I’ll never call anyone else.

reviews.author: Carmen Aguirre
reviews.text: The lady after hours was very rude. Learn how to speak to a possible customer. I decided to call someone else just because of the way she was on the phone.

reviews.author: Gary Surgeon
reviews.text: I highly recommend Hamptons Wrecker Service for all your towing & auto mechanic needs. They have been in business for years.

reviews.author: Becky Griffin
reviews.text: Shout out to our guy wearing the "niner nation" T shirt. He was very nice and got us off the side of Hwy 321, Although...AAA needs to contract more services. Hour and a half on a highway with no emergency lane is dangerous.

reviews.author: Debbie Braddy
reviews.text: Hampton's Automotive has always been great I can call them anytime they'll come to help you out ive gotten trucks stuck in the backyard locked out of my car or towing there always there Thank you guys I surely do appreciate y'all oh they've even pulled a trailer out of the yard for me so they'll be there for you. just try them

reviews.author: Carol Barrett
reviews.text: This is a late review.....after many phone calls, we found this gem of a company that was willing to help us out even though they were extremly busy as the other companies were, but were willing to make the effort to put us on their route. Thank you.

reviews.author: Sauce Mula
reviews.text: They charge entirely too much for having to get your vehicle out of the pound . My car was picked up the same day it was towed in and it was $150 and also either the tow company or the place they towed my car to cut off a piece of my Calillac converter.

reviews.author: Matthew Limone
reviews.text: I always use Hampton’s for my car inspections and mechanic needs. They are honest and don’t try to talk you in to things you don’t need.

reviews.author: Jaqueline HARRISON
reviews.text: I was stranded with my 3 large K9s...... They were timely, courteous and reasonably priced..... I SO appreciate their assistance and kindness at a stressful point in my day.

reviews.author: Nicole Corrales
reviews.text: Awesome customer service & vehicle service! Wouldn't pick any other towing company. As for me and my house, we will call Hamptons!

reviews.author: Carrie Owens
reviews.text: I was in a car accident this morning and these guys were amazing! I absolutely recommend them! Very friendly, great customer service!

reviews.author: Monica Rozzell
reviews.text: Car towed out of my clients yard due to accident. After it was told by homeowner it could stay. Had to pay 320 to get it our after someone else hit me.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Campbell
reviews.text: Driver damaged my properly and WILL NOT take responsibly for it .I wouldn't use them if I was broke down in the middle of the night alone ..

reviews.author: Bryan Jennings
reviews.text: They carry themselves in a very unprofessional manner. I wouldn't use them again if they were the only towing company around.

reviews.author: Derek Pfaff
reviews.text: Quick response, modern equipment, knowledgeable staff, problem solved! Definitely recommend A+ service!

reviews.author: Thomas Moore
reviews.text: AAA sent Hampton’s out to tow my broken down car in Hwy 321. The driver was friendly and professional. Thanks!
